company.name: AutoStream
company.tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that provides AI-powered automated video editing tools designed for YouTube creators, Instagram influencers, and professional content producers.

plans.name: Basic
plans.best_for: Hobbyists and beginners starting out with video content

plans.name: Pro
plans.best_for: Professional creators and agencies producing content at scale

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.detail: No refunds are issued after 7 days of purchase. Refund requests made within 7 days of the initial purchase date will be reviewed and processed within 3–5 business days.

policies.title: Support Availability
policies.detail: 24/7 customer support is available exclusively on the Pro plan. Basic plan users have access to email support during business hours only.

policies.title: Plan Upgrades
policies.detail: Users can upgrade from Basic to Pro at any time. The upgrade takes effect immediately and the billing difference is prorated for the remaining billing cycle.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.detail: Users can cancel their subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the current billing period. No partial refunds are issued for unused days after the 7-day refund window.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Basic and Pro plan?
faqs.a: The Basic plan costs $29/month and allows 10 videos per month at 720p resolution. The Pro plan costs $79/month and includes unlimited videos, 4K resolution, AI captions, and 24/7 support.
Yes, AI captions are available exclusively on the Pro plan at $79/month.
4K export is only available on the Pro plan. The Basic plan supports up to 720p resolution.
AutoStream offers a 7-day free trial on the Pro plan. No credit card is required to start the trial.

faqs.q: How many videos can I edit per month on the Basic plan?
faqs.a: The Basic plan allows up to 10 videos per month. If you need more, you can upgrade to the Pro plan which has no monthly video limit.
Refunds are only available within the first 7 days of purchase. After 7 days, no refunds are issued.

faqs.q: Is 24/7 support available on all plans?
faqs.a: No. 24/7 support is only available on the Pro plan. Basic plan users have email support during business hours.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro mid-month?
faqs.a: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and billing is prorated for the remainder of the current cycle.

faqs.q: What platforms does AutoStream work best for?
faqs.a: AutoStream is designed for content creators on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and other major video platforms.

faqs.q: What happens if I exceed my video limit on the Basic plan?
faqs.a: Once you reach 10 videos on the Basic plan, you will need to wait for the next billing cycle or upgrade to the Pro plan for unlimited videos.
